approved: Environment Protection and Biodiversity Conservation Amendment (Heritage Listing for the Bight) Bill 2018

The speaker moved the Environment Protection and Biodiversity Conservation Amendment (Heritage Listing for the Bight) Bill 2018 to grant National Heritage status to the Great Australian Bight, citing 74% community support and arguing that oil drilling poses catastrophic risks, with Equinor's worst-case discharge estimates of up to 7.9 million barrels.
